description: Historical observation series for a single SARB indicator, identified by its TimeseriesCode (obtain codes from home_rates, current_market_rates, cpd_rates or exchange_rates). Examples: "MMRD002A" (SARB Policy Rate — or use sarb_policy_rate directly), "MMRD000A" (prime lending rate), "EXCX135D" (Rand per US Dollar), "CPI1000F" (CPI). Optionally bound the range with start_date and end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); omit both for the most recent ~25 points, not the full history. An unknown code and a valid code with no data in range both come back as a named `no_data` error (the SARB itself cannot tell them apart).
name: sarb_timeseries
